Initial release of smyx-fish-respiratory-rate-monitor-analysis.

- Enables AI-based detection of fish respiratory rate (BPM) through aquarium camera video.
- Automatically issues hypoxia warnings and prompts water quality/temperature/health checks when abnormal respiratory rates are detected.
- Supports 7 respiratory scenarios and a 4-level alert system with clear alert escalation.
- Includes daily respiratory health reports per tank and strict compliance with privacy and open-id validation.
- Designed for integration with smart aquarium cameras in homes, public aquariums, fish farms, and laboratories.
